name: code-reviews
title: New Code Review Session
description: Creates a new package-review session, links a separate read-only original source folder, and prepares numbered rounds without copying source files.

settings.name: folder
settings.title: New session folder
settings.description: Absolute path to a new session folder; its leaf uses lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Existing folders are refused.

settings.name: original_source
settings.title: Untouched original source
settings.description: Absolute path to your existing original source directory. Linked only, never copied or modified. Must be outside the session.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Session title
settings.description: Optional display title; defaults to the session folder name.

settings.name: source_access
settings.title: Source access path on this machine
settings.description: Optional explicit access binding, such as a server share for a server-native drive path. Used only to validate access; never saved in session settings. Omit when the original source path is directly accessible.
